```{r setup}
source(here::here("R", "setup_dashboard.R"))
```

```{r}
#| label: inject-fin-data
#| results: asis
#| echo: false
if (dgfip_ready) {
  fin_for_js <- dgfip_data |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      code = code_commune,
      rec  = round(fin_recettes),
      cha  = round(fin_charges),
      det  = round(fin_dette),
      caf  = round(fin_caf),
      inv  = round(fin_invest),
      emp  = round(fin_emprunt),
      tth  = round(fin_taux_taxe_hab,   1),
      tfb  = round(fin_taux_fonc_bati,  1),
      tnb  = round(fin_taux_fonc_nbati, 1)
    )
  emit_table("finData", fin_for_js)

  cat('<script>\n',
      'window.finPalette = ', as.character(jsonlite::toJSON(PAL$blue)), ';\n',
      'window.finFields = ', '{"fin_recettes": {"key": "rec", "title": "Recettes, €/hab", "unit": "€", "digits": 0, "scale": "quantile"}, "fin_charges": {"key": "cha", "title": "Charges, €/hab", "unit": "€", "digits": 0, "scale": "quantile"}, "fin_dette": {"key": "det", "title": "Dette, €/hab", "unit": "€", "digits": 0, "scale": "quantile"}, "fin_caf": {"key": "caf", "title": "CAF, €/hab", "unit": "€", "digits": 0, "scale": "quantile"}, "fin_taux_taxe_hab": {"key": "tth", "title": "Taux de taxe d\'habitation, %", "unit": "%", "digits": 1, "scale": "quantile"}, "fin_taux_fonc_bati": {"key": "tfb", "title": "Taux de foncier bâti, %", "unit": "%", "digits": 1, "scale": "quantile"}}', ';\n',
      'window.finRecolor = function(field) {\n',
      '  var f = window.finFields[field];\n',
      '  CMap.recolor({ get: function (c) { var r = window.finData[c]; return r ? r[f.key] : null; },\n',
      '    scale: f.scale, palette: window.finPalette,\n',
      '    legend: { title: f.title, unit: f.unit, digits: f.digits, naLabel: f.na } });\n',
      '};\n',
      'window.updateFinPanel = function(code) {\n',
      '  var el = document.getElementById("fin-content");\n',
      '  if (!el) return;\n',
      '  var d = window.finData[code];\n',
      '  var elec = window.communeLookup && window.communeLookup[code];\n',
      '  var alt  = window.communeNames && window.communeNames[code];\n',
      '  var nom  = elec ? elec.nom_commune : (alt ? alt.nom : code);\n',
      '  var dept = elec ? (elec.libelle_dept + " (" + elec.code_dept + ")") : (alt ? ("Dépt " + alt.dept) : "");\n',
      '  if (!d) {\n',
      '    el.innerHTML = \'<div class="cp-header"><h3>\' + nom + \'</h3><div class="cp-meta">\' + dept + \' · \' + code + \'</div></div><div class="dvf-empty">Pas de fiche DGFiP pour cette commune.</div>\';\n',
      '    return;\n',
      '  }\n',
      '  function fmtE(x) { if (x == null) return "—"; return Number(x).toLocaleString("fr-FR") + " €"; }\n',
      '  function fmtP(x) { if (x == null) return "—"; return Number(x).toFixed(2) + " %"; }\n',
      '  function row(label, v, fmt) {\n',
      '    return \'<div class="cp-kv"><span>\' + label + \'</span><span class="cp-num">\' + fmt(v) + \'</span></div>\';\n',
      '  }\n',
      '  el.innerHTML = \'<div class="cp-header"><h3>\' + nom + \'</h3><div class="cp-meta">\' + dept + \' · \' + code + \'</div></div>\' +\n',
      '    \'<div class="cp-section"><h4>Flux financiers (€/hab, 2024)</h4>\' +\n',
      '    \'<div class="cp-kvs">\' +\n',
      '    row("Recettes", d.rec, fmtE) +\n',
      '    row("Charges",  d.cha, fmtE) +\n',
      '    row("CAF",      d.caf, fmtE) +\n',
      '    row("Dette",    d.det, fmtE) +\n',
      '    row("Investissement", d.inv, fmtE) +\n',
      '    row("Emprunts", d.emp, fmtE) +\n',
      '    \'</div></div>\' +\n',
      '    \'<div class="cp-section"><h4>Taux des taxes locales</h4>\' +\n',
      '    \'<div class="cp-kvs">\' +\n',
      '    row("Taxe habitation", d.tth, fmtP) +\n',
      '    row("Foncier bâti",    d.tfb, fmtP) +\n',
      '    row("Foncier non bâti",d.tnb, fmtP) +\n',
      '    \'</div></div>\';\n',
      '};\n',
      '</script>\n',
      sep = ""
  )
}
```

```{r}
#| label: map-fin
if (dgfip_ready) {
  vals0 <- dgfip_data |> dplyr::transmute(code_commune, value = fin_recettes)
  st_fin <- cmap_breaks(vals0$value[vals0$code_commune %in% com_metro_only$code], "quantile")
  m <- cmap_choropleth(com_metro_only, dep_metro, vals0, palette = PAL$blue,
                       legend_title = "Recettes, €/hab", unit = "€", digits = 0L,
                       scale = "quantile", breaks = st_fin)
  cmap_on_render(m, cmap_page_hooks(
    "fin", "updateFinPanel", "fin-content", "fin-ind", "finRecolor", "fin_recettes",
    ctx = list(ctx_spec("fin_recettes", "Recettes", "€/hab"), ctx_spec("fin_charges", "Charges", "€/hab"),
               ctx_spec("fin_dette", "Dette", "€/hab"), ctx_spec("fin_caf", "CAF", "€/hab"),
               ctx_spec("fin_taux_fonc_bati", "Taux de foncier bâti", "%", 1L))))
} else {
  htmltools::HTML("<p class='js-loading'>DGFiP non chargé.</p>")
}
```
:::

```{=html}
  </div>
</div>
```
